notes: TikTok connect: re-show the app's live Redirect URI on the TikTok card in Settings (under the hint). Helps diagnose TikTok's 'redirect_uri' error, which happens when the app falls back to a port other than 3000 (3001–3004) and that exact callback URL isn't registered in the TikTok app. Fix on the TikTok side: register http://localhost:3000..3004/oauth/tiktok/callback under Desktop. index.html only.
